//openTelemetry: PingGateway was the ONE component missing from the distributed trace. Every
other service reports to Jaeger (demo-api-server, mcp-gateway, mcp-server,
mcp-resource-server, authz-server, hitl-service, agent-service) — but not the
gateway that makes the authorization decision, so a trace showed the BFF's
call and the backend's work with a hole where PingGateway's P1AZ hop belongs.
OpenTelemetry is disabled by default in PingGateway and is configured HERE,
not by the OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT env the Node services use — that is a
Node SDK convention and IG ignores it.
Endpoint is OTLP/HTTP (4318, /v1/traces), NOT the 4317 gRPC port the Node
services use: this exporter takes an HTTP URL. Jaeger already listened on
4318; only its Service omitted the port (added in the same commit).
Sampling is parentBasedAlwaysOn by default, so IG joins traces the BFF has
already started rather than beginning its own — which is the point: the hop
appears inside the existing trace, not beside it.
